quotes.text: Code is like humor. When you have to explain it, it’s bad.
quotes.author: Cory House

quotes.text: Programs must be written for people to read, and only incidentally for machines to execute.
quotes.author: Harold Abelson

quotes.text: Truth can only be found in one place: the code.
quotes.author: Robert C. Martin

quotes.text: Talk is cheap. Show me the code.
quotes.author: Linus Torvalds

quotes.text: The most dangerous phrase in the language is, «We’ve always done it this way».
quotes.author: Grace Hopper

quotes.text: The best error message is the one that never shows up.
quotes.author: Thomas Fuchs

quotes.text: The most disastrous thing that you can ever learn is your first programming language.
quotes.author: Alan Kay

quotes.text: The most important property of a program is whether it accomplishes the intention of its user.
quotes.author: C.A.R. Hoare

quotes.text: The only way to learn a new programming language is by writing programs in it.
quotes.author: Dennis Ritchie

quotes.text: The only way to go fast is to go well.
quotes.author: Robert C. Martin

quotes.text: The purpose of software engineering is to control complexity, not to create it.
quotes.author: Pamela Zave

quotes.text: The question of whether computers can think is just like the question of whether submarines can swim.
quotes.author: Edsger W. Dijkstra

quotes.text: The sooner you start to code, the longer the program will take.
quotes.author: Roy Carlson

quotes.text: The trouble with programmers is that you can never tell what a programmer is doing until it’s too late.
quotes.author: Seymour Cray

quotes.text: The truth is that most software is written by a small number of people. What’s important is how they work together.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.text: Curse of the self-taught: fear that you know only points here and there, islands of knowledge, and between them are chasms into which you will fall in humiliating failure, a fear that followed me from the first time I learned how to code.
quotes.author: Ellen Ullman

quotes.text: Programming isn’t about what you know; it’s about what you can figure out.
quotes.author: Chris Pine

quotes.text: Code is read much more often than it is written
quotes.author: Guido van Rossum

quotes.text: This was one of the best parts of being a coder, and an artist: the thrill of being in the middle of creating something delightful. It’s like the anticipation of eating freshly baked bread after its aroma fills the room.
quotes.author: Dr. Joy Buolamwini

quotes.text: Every great developer you know got there by solving problems they were unqualified to solve until they actually did it.
quotes.author: Patrick McKenzie

quotes.text: The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
quotes.author: Alan Kay

quotes.text: The code you write makes you a programmer. The code you delete makes you a good one. The code you don’t have to write makes you a great one.
quotes.author: Mario Fusco
